title: Crispy Lamb Kebabs
description: A classic Middle Eastern-inspired dish featuring crispy lamb kebabs, perfect for a quick dinner. Serve with your favorite sides or salads.

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: Make sure to trim any excess fat

ingredients.name: Syrian za'atar
ingredients.notes: You can also use regular za'atar or oregano

instructions: Preheat your grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, za'atar, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until they're cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Brush the kebabs with additional olive oil during the last 2 minutes of grilling.
Serve the kebabs hot with crispy pita bread and garnish with parsley, if desired.
Optional: Serve with your favorite sides or salads, such as a simple green salad or a side of hummus.
